name: Confronting Sins
overview: Scripture instructs believers to lovingly and privately address sin within the community, emphasizing restoration over condemnation. When a brother sins, the goal is to gently rebuke and seek repentance, as seen in Matthew 18:15 and Luke 17:3, with forgiveness following genuine repentance. Galatians 6:1 highlights the need for meekness and self-examination in this process, while Ephesians 4:15 calls for speaking truth in love to promote spiritual growth in Christ. James 5:19 further underscores the importance of turning a brother back to the truth when he has wandered.
